payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Brain, Logan, Milly, Ronna

payload.content: I have strong skills in documentation and data-science but only 5 hours available. The low priority tasks related to infrastructure (ISSUE-0002) have very high costs for me, so they are not a good fit. I prefer to focus on the documentation tasks with lower effort and cost, especially ISSUE-0001::triage or ISSUE-0001::review or ISSUE-0001::docs, as they fit my skills and availability better. I plan to avoid tasks that exceed my availability or have very high cost.
Could others please share their availability and preferred tasks? This will help us avoid duplicate claims and maximize the number of tasks completed efficiently.

However, my costs for these tasks vary, and I want to avoid overlapping with others' preferences. I am currently evaluating ISSUE-0001::triage and ISSUE-0001::review as potential options given their effort and cost.
